clue.text: Exceptional hit to get pigeon with gun that's no good

parts.note: a homer is a homing pigeon

indicators.note: no here means without, so the letter for good is dropped from gun

parts.note: taken as written before its letter is removed

explanation.surface: A shooter bags a pigeon with a dud gun and calls it a great shot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no' means without: the gun loses its good, and a homer is a racing pigeon bred to fly home.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball a home run is the outstanding hit that clears the field, letting the batter circle every base.

clue.text: King's wife in explosive country

parts.note: HE is high explosive
Cuba is a Caribbean country

explanation.surface: A royal consort caught up in a volatile nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Hecuba was the wife of King Priam of Troy in Greek legend.

clue.text: Yarn from doctor about Ireland

indicators.note: about means going around, so the doctor wraps round the other piece

parts.note: MO is a medical officer
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

explanation.surface: A doctor spins a tale about Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yarn' suggests a story, but it is wool.
explanation.definitionFit: Merino is fine wool yarn from the merino breed of sheep.

clue.text: Judge again is to receive plaudits

parts.note: to reap is to receive as a reward
plaudits are praise

explanation.surface: A judge returns to collect applause.
explanation.definitionFit: To reappraise is to assess or evaluate once more, judging something a second time.

clue.text: Hard substance containing nitrogen on part of the estate?

indicators.note: on places the symbol in front in this down clue

parts.note: N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen
an acre is a unit of land, a piece of an estate

explanation.surface: Fertiliser is spread on the fields of a country estate.
explanation.definitionFit: Nacre, or mother-of-pearl, is the hard iridescent substance lining shells.

clue.text: Scrap involving American gunman creates scene of confusion

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the scrap wraps round the gunman

parts.note: a scrap is a small bit
Wyatt Earp was the American lawman and gunfighter of the OK Corral

explanation.surface: A Wild West shootout causes chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A bear pit is figurative for a rowdy, chaotic place such as a heated debating chamber.

clue.text: Fuss after former Arsenal player's given old-fashioned punishment

indicators.note: after puts the fuss behind the player's name

parts.note: Cliff Bastin was an Arsenal and England forward of the 1930s
ado is fuss

explanation.surface: A fuss after a footballer is punished in the old way.
explanation.walkthrough: Arsenal is a London football club; Cliff Bastin was its star winger in the 1930s.
explanation.definitionFit: The bastinado was a historic punishment of beating the soles of the feet.

clue.text: Got down the catalogue of those coming first, not second

indicators.note: not means the letter for second is left out

parts.words: the catalogue of those coming first
parts.note: the A-list is the roster of top people

explanation.surface: Removed from the list of winners, a runner-up dismounts.
explanation.definitionFit: Alit is the past tense of alight, to get down from a vehicle or horse.

clue.text: Fruit that's unattractive with insect in it

indicators.note: in places the insect inside the other word

parts.note: plain means unattractive
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: An ugly piece of fruit with a bug in it.
explanation.definitionFit: The plantain is a starchy banana-like fruit used in cooking.

clue.text: Pick times for listeners — slots near the middle of the week

definitions.text: slots near the middle of the week

indicators.note: for listeners means the words are said aloud to give the answer

parts.note: to pick is to choose and times are days

explanation.surface: Choosing time slots in the middle of the week.
explanation.walkthrough: CHOOSE DAYS said aloud sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The second day of the working week falls near its middle, and these are recurring slots.

clue.text: Girl takes vehicle to US city

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
LA is Los Angeles

explanation.surface: A young woman drives off to Los Angeles.
explanation.definitionFit: Carla is a girl's name, the usual crossword sense of girl.

clue.text: Rebuke players getting one wicket?

parts.note: the cast are the players in a show
I is the Roman numeral one
a wicket is a small gate, a sense older than cricket

explanation.surface: A cricket team is scolded for taking just one wicket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wicket' points at cricket, but here it is the old word for a small gate or door.
explanation.definitionFit: To castigate is to reprimand severely, a synonym of rebuke.

clue.text: Nasty smell with vessel in kitchen going over — little encouragement to enjoy food!

parts.note: BO is body odour

indicators.note: going over means turning upside down, read backwards in an across clue

parts.note: a pan is a cooking vessel
petit is French for little

explanation.surface: A smelly kitchen with a pan tipped over offers diners scant encouragement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going over' turns PAN into NAP; 'little' is French PETIT, fitting the French phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase wishing diners a good meal is said to urge people to enjoy their food.

clue.text: Half the folk at university wanted virile young man

indicators.note: half signals keeping only the first half of the word

parts.note: students are the people at university

explanation.surface: Half the students wanted a handsome young man.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is slang for a sexually attractive, virile young man.

clue.text: Musical instruction briefly conveyed by Suppe

definitions.text: Musical instruction briefly conveyed by Suppe

parts.words: Musical instruction briefly conveyed by Suppe
parts.note: the abbreviation pp sits inside the composer's name Suppe, so his name carries the shortened marking for very soft playing

explanation.surface: A direction in a score by the composer Suppé.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' means the instruction appears in short form, pp, which Suppe literally contains.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian marking means very softly, abbreviated pp in a score.

clue.text: A girl, British one aflame with yen to show appeal to her man?

parts.note: Dora is a girl's name
I is the Roman numeral one
lit means alight, on fire
Y is the symbol for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A British girl burns with longing to attract her man.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is playful: the girl's lovability is her appeal to her man.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lovable or cute is the charm a partner finds attractive, which is what the word names.

clue.text: Attack on street stifling roar maybe

indicators.note: stifling means smothering, so the street wraps round the roar

parts.note: a roar of laughter is one kind of laugh

explanation.surface: A violent assault in the street, silencing a shout.
explanation.definitionFit: An onslaught is a fierce attack.

clue.text: Idea sung about in part of Mass

indicators.note: about here means mixed around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thought sung during the church service.
explanation.definitionFit: The Agnus Dei, Lamb of God, is a section of the Mass liturgy.

clue.text: Old women could provide bed and meals

indicators.note: could provide suggests the letters can be rearranged to produce the answer

explanation.surface: Elderly ladies running a bed and breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: Beldam is an archaic word for an old woman, often a hag.

clue.text: Yes, aprons go messy herein

indicators.note: messy suggests the letters thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Aprons get filthy in this sort of place.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: aprons do get messy in a cheap café.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheap, grubby café is called this, and its fry-ups do mess up aprons.

clue.text: The alien plant must come up using this?

definitions.text: The alien plant must come up using this?

indicators.note: come up signals reading upwards in a down clue

parts.note: le is the French for the, so a foreign 'the'
wort is an old word for a plant

explanation.surface: A gardener digs out an invasive weed.
explanation.walkthrough: LEWORT read upwards gives the answer; the whole clue also describes digging up a weed with a garden tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A gardener uses this small hand tool to dig up plants.

clue.text: Bird starts to kiss you, showing off

parts.note: a swan is a bird

indicators.note: starts to means taking the first letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A bird preens and blows kisses.
explanation.definitionFit: Swanky means flashy or ostentatious, given to showing off.

clue.text: Our duty is to embrace a foreign language

indicators.note: to embrace means to hold within, so the answer sits inside these words

explanation.surface: Learning a foreign tongue is our obligation.
explanation.definitionFit: Urdu is the national language of Pakistan, foreign to a British solver.

clue.text: Sham argument from one of the foreign secretary's supporters?

definitions.meaning: a straw-man argument misrepresents the opposing case so as to knock it down easily

definitions.text: one of the foreign secretary's supporters?
definitions.meaning: Jack Straw was the British Foreign Secretary, so his supporter is playfully one of his men

explanation.surface: A weak argument from a minister's backer.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a weak argument set up to be knocked down, and literally a follower of Jack Straw.

clue.text: Hidden? Not initially — anything but

indicators.note: not initially means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: covert means hidden

explanation.surface: Is it secret? Quite the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anything but' refers back to Hidden: overt is the opposite of hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and plain to see, the opposite of being concealed.

clue.text: Modern drug knocking six out in Indian city

indicators.note: knocking ... out means removing the Roman six
out completes the removal signal

parts.note: Viagra is a modern impotence drug
VI is Roman six

explanation.surface: A drug with its six taken out leaves an Indian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Agra is a city in northern India, home of the Taj Mahal.

clue.text: Agitator expected to hold them enthralled

indicators.note: to hold means to contain, so the expected word goes round the rest

parts.note: due means expected
'em is a casual form of them
agog means eagerly enthralled

explanation.surface: A rabble-rouser is expected to keep the crowd spellbound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'them' becomes the casual 'em, a common crossword shortening.
explanation.definitionFit: A demagogue is a political agitator who stirs up crowds by appealing to prejudice.

clue.text: Man losing head on island is from Des Moines, perhaps

indicators.note: on places the shortened man next to the island

parts.note: IOW is the Isle of Wight, an island off southern England

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter of the word goes

parts.note: taken as written before its first letter goes

explanation.surface: A headless man on an island turns out to be from the American Midwest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' tempts as the Isle of Man, but it simply loses M to give AN.
explanation.definitionFit: Des Moines is the capital of Iowa, so someone from there is from that state.

clue.text: In international, Matthews could be twinkling

indicators.note: in places one piece inside another

parts.note: Sir Stanley Matthews, the English footballer, was known as Stan

explanation.surface: Matthews could sparkle when playing for his country.
explanation.walkthrough: Stanley Matthews was a famous English footballer of the 1940s and 50s, capped for England.
explanation.definitionFit: A twinkling, as in the twinkling of an eye, is a moment or instant.

clue.text: One of the porters' conveyances they trundle for hospital

indicators.note: for signals replacing one piece with another

parts.note: taken as written before a letter is swapped
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
to trundle is to roll along

explanation.surface: Hospital porters push their carts along the corridors.
explanation.walkthrough: ROLL replaces the H of THEY.
explanation.definitionFit: A hospital porter wheels patients and goods on a trolley, a wheeled cart.
